tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions as per tender documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Should have experience of providing staff services to government institutions such as Social Welfare Department/Backward Classes Welfare Department/Minority Welfare Department hostels/residential schools or institutions of Women and Child Development Department as an external resource agency in the years 2023-24, 2024-25 2025-26. And in this regard, the information on the services of the staff currently called for tender by the department and a copy of the work order and experience certificates (the Head of the Department who received the service should confirm the number of staff provided each year) should be submitted in consolidated information only for the posts mentioned in Form-1. (Information on the provision of staff services to posts other than the posts for which tenders are currently being called and information on posts and years other than 2023-24 to 2025-26 included in Form-1 will be considered as incorrect/incomplete information and will be rejected. Failure to attach the work order and experience certificates matching the details entered in Form-1 will be considered as incorrect/incomplete information and will be rejected.)
The organization should be a registered manpower organization. Certificate of registration under the Societies Registration Act or the Companies Act.

Certificate of registration under the Karnataka Shops and Commercial Institutions Act in Form-''C'' obtained from the competent authority. (Must be registered for at least 500 employees) Should be valid for the current year.
Certificate of registration with the Professional Tax Department.
Challan copies of professional tax paid up to the month preceding the date of tender notification for the years 2023-24, 2024-25 2025-26 and 2026-27.
Certificate of registration with the Employees' Provident Fund (EPF).
Details of challans paid by EPF as per rules up to the month preceding the date of tender notification for the years 2023-24, 2024-25 2025-26 and 2026-27.
ESI Registration Certificate
Details of challans paid to ESI as per rules up to the month preceding the date of tender notification for the years 2023-24, 2024-25 2025-26 and 2026-27.

Elected members, blacklisted organizations will not be allowed to participate in the tender and a notarial affidavit on a stamped paper of Rs. 500.00 stating that they are not included in the blacklist and are not elected members.

Previously, while providing outsourcing services, there are no complaints against the outsourcing agency by any district government department or the outsourcing agency has not been rejected in tenders, stating that the service is not adequate. A 500rs notary Stamp paper should be submitted
Document regarding having an office locally / Affidavit regarding opening an office on a stamped paper of Rs. 500.00.

Current valid trade license letter obtained from the Municipal Corporation / Municipal Council / Town Panchayat / Municipality / Competent Authority regarding the establishment of the agency. The copy of the trade license submitted by the agency should be a copy of the license obtained from the local authority of the office address submitted in the tender document.
Submission of Police Verification Report. Should be valid for the current year.
Bank Solvency Certificate (30% of the tender amount) (60,00,000) obtained from a Nationalized Bank in the name of the tendering authority (60,00,000)
The organization should have IS certificate in its name and should be renewed for the current year.
FSAI (Fire and Security Association of India) from the Fire Department is attached.
Submission of Form-''D'' obtained from the Labor Department regarding the contribution paid to the Workers' Welfare Fund in the last three years.
EMD of rupees 3,00,000 Paid details
PAN Card
GST Registration certificate
GST payment GST R 3B and 9 submission up to the month preceding the date of tender notification for the years 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26 and 2026-27.
Submit income tax paid for the year 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 (assessment year) along with profit and loss and balance sheet details.

The organization should have handled a minimum average turnover of Rs. 200.00 lakhs as an external resource agency in the last 3 years (2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26) and submit a certified copy obtained from a Chartered Accountant as mentioned in Annexure-4. (If information is not submitted in the prescribed format, it will be considered incomplete / incorrect information and will be rejected)
